lastWeekKeyChanges.title: Tesla robotaxi expands to Miami and Dallas on July 3
lastWeekKeyChanges.description: On July 3, 2026, Tesla expanded its unsupervised robotaxi service to Miami and Dallas, marking continued geographic expansion of the Cybercab platform. City officials report Tesla's Austin fleet at approximately 50 vehicles despite a year of operation. lastWeekKeyChanges.title: Denmark becomes fourth European country to approve FSD on June 9
lastWeekKeyChanges.description: Denmark greenlit Tesla FSD Supervised on June 9, 2026, following Netherlands (April 10), Lithuania (May 20), and Estonia (May 29). The Dutch vehicle authority RDW granted the first European type approval, and Tesla anticipates EU-wide recognition during summer 2026 through mutual recognition, potentially extending access to Germany, France, and other major markets without repeating the full 18-month review process. Tesla now has FSD Supervised available in 12 countries globally.

lastWeekKeyChanges.title: Optimus production confirmed for late July/August 2026 at Fremont
lastWeekKeyChanges.description: During Tesla's Q1 2026 earnings call, Elon Musk confirmed that Optimus humanoid robot production will commence in late July or August 2026 at the Fremont factory. The facility, converted from Model S/X production (final vehicles produced May 2026), targets 1 million units annually. Musk cautioned that initial output will be 'quite slow' due to 10,000 unique parts across an entirely new production line. Tesla is simultaneously constructing a second-generation Optimus facility at Giga Texas targeting 10 million units per year, with production starting summer 2027.

lastWeekKeyChanges.title: Tesla completes 46-day Model S/X line teardown for Optimus at Fremont
lastWeekKeyChanges.description: Tesla Manufacturing posted a video on July 10, 2026 showing the original Model S and Model X assembly line at Fremont decommissioned in just 46 days — concrete pits, robotic arms, and conveyors removed. The post, captioned 'End of an era,' confirms the floor is being repurposed for Optimus. Limited Gen 3 production is already underway; full-scale output on the converted line remains targeted for late July or August 2026 with a long-term capacity ambition of 1 million units per year at Fremont.

Works on HW3 (not only HW4); vehicle software 2026.20.6.1 ~40% fleet rollout
Directly useful for owners whose cars earn robotaxi revenue
negative_signals: Does not expand fleet size or unsupervised city coverage by itself
Still depends on vehicle software rollout reaching the full fleet

key_metrics.target: Remote fleet management for owner-operated robotaxi network
key_metrics.trajectory: Infrastructure for scaled owner fleet; not yet a volume milestone

lastWeekKeyChanges.title: Tesla app adds live Self-Driving indicator for robotaxi owners
lastWeekKeyChanges.description: Tesla app version 4.58.5 (reported July 7, 2026) displays a live blue 'Self-Driving' indicator under the speed readout when FSD is engaged, plus the glowing blue navigation path. Confirmed working on HW3 Model S. Vehicle-side software 2026.20.6.1 has reached ~40% of the fleet. For owners whose vehicles generate robotaxi revenue, this turns the app into a basic fleet monitor — especially relevant as unsupervised service runs in Miami and other cities.

sentiment.headline: positive
sentiment.rationale: Official confirmation of voice-taught contextual FSD and a September Grok→planning timeline is progress, but it is a roadmap commitment — not a shipped capability yet.

positive_signals: Ashok Elluswamy confirmed voice-taught, remembered contextual FSD instructions (July 8)
Musk: Grok voice commands to FSD planning layer targeted by September 2026
Directly improves last-100-feet robotaxi pickup/dropoff quality at scale
negative_signals: Feature not shipped yet — testing burden for safety (e.g. refusing unsafe commands)
September timeline is guidance, not a release

key_metrics.actual: Confirmed on roadmap; Grok in-car exists but has no FSD authority today
key_metrics.target: Grok voice → FSD planning by September 2026

lastWeekKeyChanges.title: Tesla confirms voice-taught FSD context; Grok→planning by September
lastWeekKeyChanges.description: On July 8, 2026, Tesla VP of AI Software Ashok Elluswamy confirmed Tesla is building a feature that lets drivers teach the car hyper-local context in plain language (e.g. which driveway) with the instruction remembered for future trips. Elon Musk separately confirmed Grok voice commands will pass into FSD's planning layer by September 2026. This is infrastructure for both consumer FSD and robotaxi last-mile pickup quality, but remains unreleased pending safety testing.
